audit.summary: The unrestricted reading of the diagram-defined cover family in Proposition6.5 has an exact torsion counterexample; the actual coprime-degree motivic subclass is not identified here. Independently, its multi-factor reverse induction invokes a smooth-boundary lemma on a crossing boundary. Lemma6.18, the orbit site, coarse fixed stacks and arbitrary-gerbe scope have the separately recorded defects. Final Higgs-moduli conclusions are not disproved.
limitations: Scope of the cover torsion claim and the singular-boundary induction — Counterevidence: Prop6.5 does not explicitly say for all l,k. The preceding coprime-degree motivic construction may select a narrower subclass. The explicit example has sum(k_i*l_i)=2, not coprime to n2; its occurrence in that subclass is unproved. Repeated weights are not prohibited by the diagram or bundle calculation, but this does not prove membership. Coprimality does not remove the independent local crossing geometry of the Step2 product-open boundary.

Finite p-cover trivialization does not force fiber torsion to survive global sections — Counterevidence: Automorphism preserves torsion subgroup but need not chosen free complement; (z,t)->(z,t+z modp) exhibits mixing. No claim this HZ-spectrum is actual Higgs KU spectrum. Stronger helper KU-module variant not independently adopted.

Finite p-cover trivialization does not force fiber torsion to survive global sections — Counterevidence: The torsion subgroup is invariant, but an arbitrary chosen free complement need not be: on pi0, (z,t)->(z,t+z mod p). No realization as the particular Higgs KU local system is asserted; a stronger auxiliary KU-module variant was not adopted.

Partial-domain orbit morphisms violate stability of the stated covering rule — Counterevidence: Counterexample is finite-dimensional locally compact Hausdorff complex analytic with nonempty fixed locus. Taking generated topology is not a repair. Does not itself refute final KU equivalence.

Partial-domain orbit morphisms violate stability of the stated covering rule — Counterevidence and scope: This is a failure of the proposed general site and a foundation used by Section5. It is not a counterexample to the final K-theory equivalence.

Coarse fixed points do not provide well-defined orbit action maps for stacks — Counterevidence: Actual main p21 target is described as having trivialGamma-action; this stack example not proved to occur in that application.

Coarse fixed points do not provide well-defined orbit action maps for stacks — Counterevidence and scope: The actual main construction's target on p.21 is described with trivial Gamma action, so this example is not asserted to occur in that narrower application. Major concerns the stated general stack framework used to justify the construction.

Arbitrary Brauer class is replaced by the canonical obstruction gerbe without justification — Counterevidence: If Cor6.16 intended only canonical gerbe, alpha0 example does not refute that restricted version. Theorem6.11 itself not disproved.

Arbitrary Brauer class is replaced by the canonical obstruction gerbe without justification — Counterevidence and scope: If Corollary6.16 is read as only canonical-obstruction-gerbe specific, that restricted assertion is not refuted. It then cannot justify Theorem6.11's arbitrary-alpha argument without additional proof. No false final Theorem6.11 conclusion is claimed.

Support must be checked for every simple perverse constituent — Counterevidence: Situation3.8(b) already states stronger middle-extension condition. No main application counterexample from this local issue.
Extension construction takes quotient instead of kernel — Counterevidence: Root verified local correction; not a counterexample to existence of coherent/twisted extension.

Internal mapping object does not preserve arbitrary colimits of spaces — Counterevidence: LemmaA.21 target identity not itself refuted; stable finiteproducts/coproducts coincide so this spacecounterexample not automaticstablecounterexample.
Single-factor isogeny pullback has m^(2g) components — Counterevidence: Single-factor torsion-free argument survives; doesnotfixtwo-factorProp6.5.
Prym torsor cohomology uses the wrong genus in its rank — Counterevidence: Subsequent range already usesg_C; intendedPrym equivalence not refuted.
